# Gramlot 0.3.1 — Responsive gallery support

- Python and JavaScript server bootstraps declare the device-width viewport, preventing desktop-width scaling on phones.
- The optional inspector can switch dynamically between floating and docked presentation without rebuilding its runtime, selection or connections.
- Docked inspector tabs, rows, property editors and splitter have larger touch targets; breakpoint controls remain reachable without hover.
- Existing desktop inspector, Source/Data editing, breakpoints and embedded DevTools presentation remain available.

Pair this core with the updated gramlot-examples gallery. The gallery supplies its responsive navigation and Example/Code/Inspector views; the core does not depend on examples.

Verified locally: 3,544 JavaScript checks, 16 Python server checks, 30 inspector checks, Chromium/WebKit inspector qualification, and Python/Node gallery mobile/desktop checks. Release CI also runs the full core and browser qualification before publishing.
